recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-31876 unless BR&R later reopens the substance modeling question or requests an extension for specified-substance details.
issue_request: FHIR-31876 asked BR&R to resolve duplicate Ingredient.substance and Ingredient.specificSubstance modeling for the R4B MedicinalProductIngredient/Ingredient artifact by simplifying to one substance representation. Jira status is Published with a Persuasive resolution applied for R5.
initial_application: The change was explicitly applied in source history by commit 6b369be0a3586b4327b7be45bb93e65c344f66e0, which removed Ingredient.specifiedSubstance, its search parameters, and the specified-substance example for FHIR#31813/FHIR#31815/FHIR#31816/FHIR#31876. The same patch appears as 5730009f8bc3d8edcbaba2bbf979741b55017c7b on another branch, consistent with Jira's note that the change was applied in both R4B and main.
additional_context: Ingredient is active in the current build and fhir.ini redirects the old MedicinalProductIngredient name to Ingredient. Related issues FHIR-31813, FHIR-31815, and FHIR-31816 are the same simplification family. A 2020 BR&R Zulip thread explains the original specifiedSubstance/substance modeling confusion, and 2021-10-05 BR&R minutes confirm related work-group approval that the Substance/SpecifiedSubstance model had been simplified. Direct FHIR-31876 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit.
